title: Sahityar Satya: Critical Studies on Literature, Society and Culture
author: Dr. Hiren Gohain
genre: Literary Criticism, Cultural Sociology & Intellectual Historiography
description: Seminal collection of critical essays by renowned intellectual Dr. Hiren Gohain, examining the socio-historical development of Assamese literature, oral folk traditions of indigenous ethnic groups, trans-Patkai tribal migrations, medieval chronicles, and the humanist ethos of Northeastern India.
